bio_en: Davit Papazian was born in Van in 1884 and completed his secondary education at the Yeramian school, then became a teacher in Van, Shatakh and Aghtamar. He belonged to the generation formed by Portugalian's call in Van, which first took up arms openly in 1896, and he saw national education as the foundation of revival. A lifelong ARF member, he was among the last of the old generation of Vaspurakan. He died in 1961 in Iran, where Alik published his eulogy.
